data.name: Mutant Baby Remover
data.shortDescription: A mod that removes mutant babies and replaces them with other enemies.
data.description:
Do you absolutely detest mutant babies? If so this is the mod for you!  Not only does this mod remove mutant babies, but it lets you replace them with other way cooler enemies. In the config options you can set the enemies you want mutant baby spawns to be replaced with or none all. Just delete them and be done with it. There is also a spawn babies key for you to test this mod out yourself without having to find some first. 

Warning! Be very careful. Mutant babies usually spawn in large numbers. So if you replace them with tough enemies there will be lots of them. 

This mod doesn't change the spawn rate in any way. Plays well with raid customizer. Should work in multiplayer too.

Works for all mutant baby spawns. Including those in caves and those spawned directly via command.
